name: neighbors-kitchen
description: Community marketplace connecting local home chefs with their neighbors

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node backend/scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:start --prefix backend && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate:deploy --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npm run db:start --prefix backend && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "PORT=4000 npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
